title: Guild Wars 2
provenance: AppleGamingWiki rates it Perfect through CrossOver and through Wine, with reports from an M2 Mac mini (Game Porting Toolkit with Whisky, 100 to 140 fps at low settings) and an M4 Max (CrossOver, 80 to 120 fps at 4K high). Measured here on an M4 with macOS 27.0 on 2026-10-01, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r17 with DXMT and msync. The Steam copy's launcher renders, shows the game fully downloaded (Playable, Ready) and reaches the ArenaNet display-name step. The game itself was not started here.
notes: Free to play on Steam, about 90 GB. Its launcher opens on KLYC-Box's default setup and, on a first start, asks for an ArenaNet display name to link to your Steam account before the game starts. Only the launcher was exercised here, so no frame rate was measured. AppleGamingWiki's Wine entry says to turn esync off. KLYC-Box uses msync, a different mechanism. If the game hangs, set the environment's Synchronization to None.
